jobs.occupation: Post-Doc position: AI-Driven Robotic Experimentation for Controlling Metal Degradation (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Metal degradation can be a boon or a bane, depending on the application and on how well we can control it. A corroding car component is a safety risk. A biodegradable metal implant that dissolves at exactly the right rate spares patients a second surgery. An aqueous battery lives or dies depending on what happens at its electrodes.At the Department of Electrochemistry and Big Data we unravel degradation pathways of light metals used in structural applications, medical devices and aqueous batteries. For these applications, degradation can be controlled using tailored electrolyte additives. The chemical space of possible additives is virtually infinite, so we do not test one-by-one. We run a robotic, high-throughput testing platform coupled with machine learning and AI agents that help to decide which experiment to run next. Join us to build the self-driving laboratory of corrosion science.We are offering a 2‑year Post-Doctoral position, as soon as possible, in the quickly developing field of robotic experimentation in materials science.
